title.zh: 【港交所旗下 LME 探索将存放于香港仓库的金属库存代币化】
title.en: 【港交所旗下 LME 探索将存放于香港仓库的金属库存代币化】

current_state.zh: The London Metal Exchange, owned by HKEX, is in early-stage exploration of tokenizing metal inventory stored in Hong Kong warehouses so it can serve as collateral for lending and other financing, with an invitation-only industry roundtable set for early November alongside HKEX's carbon-credit tokenization trials.
current_state.en: The London Metal Exchange, owned by HKEX, is in early-stage exploration of tokenizing metal inventory stored in Hong Kong warehouses so it can serve as collateral for lending and other financing, with an invitation-only industry roundtable set for early November alongside HKEX's carbon-credit tokenization trials.
